skip newest submitted pick older unsubmi: Claude 2026-11-11: the spec's rule 1 (any unsubmitted folder of the job, newest first) was unsafe — the real data home has this exact shape (an employer J16060: 11-10 dry-run folder unsubmitted, the job submitted from the 11-11 folder). Reusing the older folder would put an already-submitted job back into a batch under a folder that results.jsonl does not mark as submitted. The code stops at the newest submitted folder: a folder older than a submitted one is superseded, so a new date folder is made. The case follows the old spec; the code's behaviour is the intended one.
